v9-home:v9-home.sections.6.body: APR 70 is one writer-producer and a working slate of **ten properties**: three features drafted, a ten-episode season on the page, more in development. Nine titles are public on the [slate](/slate), each with its own page. One travels only inside private materials while legal counsel review completes. The scripts are written by people. The machine works below the line, on frames like the ones on this site, and it is disclosed wherever it works.

v9-methods:v9-methods.sections.2.rows.6.definition: Because trust is the only asset a small studio owns outright. And because the work we sell, the writing, must be human work, plainly and provably.
